k:緻.mnemonic: The weaver doth (致) pack each thread (糸) so tightly against the next that no gap shows anywhere in the cloth. Fine (i.e. not coarse).

k:繭.mnemonic: Under the flowers (艹), a grub spins thread (糸) around itself into a snug hood (冂) that keeps out the wind (風) while it changes. Cocoon.

k:楷.mnemonic: A tree (木) whose branches all (皆) grow at tidy right angles: handwriting where every stroke is separate, straight and correct. Square character style (correctness).

k:璧.mnemonic: Where the king (王) and his spicy (辛) tempered queen reside (居), a flat green ring of polished stone hangs on the wall, the treasure of the realm. Jade disc (jewel, sphere, ball).
k:璧.hint: A green stone ring on the palace wall.

k:塡.mnemonic: Ten (十) holes in the road. You shovel soil (土) into each and check by eye (目) that it sits level with the top. Fill in (fill up, make good).

k:憬.mnemonic: A postcard of far-off scenery (景) hangs on the wall, and your heartbeat (忄) quickens each time you look: one day you will go there. Yearn for (aspire to, admire).

k:謄.mnemonic: Every month (月) the clerk writes out again exactly what the registers say (言). Heaven (天) help him if a single stroke differs. Mimeograph (copy).

k:錮.mnemonic: Molten gold (金) is poured around the cell door and left to harden (固). No key will ever open it now. Confinement (to tie).
k:錮.hint: A cell door sealed in metal.

k:璽.mnemonic: Again (再) and again the carved block comes down on the decree, its criss-cross (爻) pattern pressed in red. Only one man may use it. Emperor's seal.
k:璽.hint: A carved block pressed in red.

k:頰.mnemonic: A big (大) person (人) pops a whole shellfish (貝) into each side of his mouth like a hamster and puffs at the menu page (頁). Cheeks (jaw).
